parent_objective: implement closed-loop capability corpus and matched-current pair runner after M594 design

public_gates: implement corpus exporter and focused tests only
store P0 observations anchors and training-only capability labels
mine or export matched-current pair rows from the same corpus
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add capability labels or hidden physical parameters to actor observations
do not claim driver performance from corpus export
hypothesis: A closed-loop BC5660 capability corpus runner can align P0 observations, base action anchors, recurrent state diagnostics, future-response labels, and matched-current pair-ranking rows without actor-input leakage.
success_criteria: implementation writes capability_corpus.npz pairs.csv summaries and metadata
tests verify corpus arrays have expected shapes and exclude privileged actor inputs
tests verify pair rows reference valid corpus row indices and target deltas
tests verify future-response labels are stored as targets only
failure_criteria: implementation feeds capability labels into actor observations
implementation writes invalid pair row indices
implementation trains or promotes a checkpoint

commands.name: tests
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_bc_capability_corpus.py tests/test_bc_capability_repair.py

decision_rule: M595 passes if it implements tested corpus and pair-runner infrastructure without training, PPO, promotion, or actor-input leakage.
